result_text:
I fixed the export so `all_files.zip` takes its entry names from the configured aspect names instead of fixed literals. It compiles (`mvn -o -pl reports compile`). I didn't run any tests or try a renamed aspect, so the rename case is untested.

The change is in `DataExporter.java`, in the zip-writing block at the end of the data export. It now builds the five entries (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) in that order. Each name comes from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same helper that writes the loose `aspect_*.txt` files, so the names always match.

With the default configuration the entries are the same as before. With `buildAndDeployment` as the aspect name, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. Since `all_files.zip` no longer fails, `git-history.zip` is written too when `git-history.txt` exists.

`LandscapeAnalyzer.java` (lines 280–284) still has the same fixed `aspect_*.txt` names. It looks up those files across repositories, so a renamed aspect would miss there as well. I left it alone because it's outside this task.
